questions.question: Which of the following traversal outputs the data in sorted order in a BST?
questions.explanation: Inorder traversal of a BST always gives elements in ascending sorted order.

questions.question: An array consists of n elements. We want to create a heap using the elements. The time complexity of building a heap will be in order of -
questions.explanation: Building a heap from n elements takes O(n log n) time using the top-down approach; bottom-up is O(n).

questions.question: The time complexity of binary search algorithm is -
questions.explanation: Binary search divides the search space in half each time, giving O(log n) time complexity.

questions.question: Which data structure is used to represent complex relationships between the nodes?
questions.explanation: Graphs represent complex, non-hierarchical relationships between nodes using vertices and edges.

questions.question: In the given connected graph G, what is the value of rad(G) and diam(G)?
questions.explanation: Radius is the minimum eccentricity and diameter is the maximum eccentricity of the graph. rad(G)=2, diam(G)=3.

questions.question: If f(n) = 5n³ + 4n² - 8n + 100, then f(n) =
questions.explanation: The highest degree term is 5n³, so f(n) = O(n³) — Big-O is determined by the dominant term.

What is the maximum number of swaps that can be performed in the Selection Sort algorithm for 'n' number of elements?
questions.explanation: Selection sort makes at most n-1 swaps — one swap per pass, and there are n-1 passes.

questions.question: How do you initialize an array in C?
questions.explanation: In C, arrays are initialized with curly braces: int arr[3] = {1,2,3}; is the correct syntax.

In a Binary Search Tree, the left subtree of a node contains -

options.A: Nodes with keys greater than the node's key
options.B: Nodes with keys less than the node's key
options.C: Nodes with keys equal to the node's key

questions.explanation: In a BST, the left subtree of any node contains only nodes with keys less than the node's key.

questions.question: What is the worst case time complexity for searching an element in a BST?
questions.explanation: In the worst case (skewed tree), BST search degenerates to O(n) as every node must be checked.

Which data structure uses a hash function to map keys to their associated values?
questions.explanation: A hash table uses a hash function to compute an index for storing and retrieving key-value pairs.

questions.question: Which of the following is a method to resolve collision in hashing?
questions.explanation: Linear probing, chaining, and quadratic probing are all valid collision resolution techniques in hashing.

Dijkstra's algorithm is used to find -

options.B: Shortest path from a single source to all other vertices
options.C: Shortest path between all pairs of vertices

questions.explanation: Dijkstra's algorithm finds the shortest path from a single source vertex to all other vertices in a weighted graph.

questions.question: Which shortest path algorithm can handle graphs with negative edge weights?
questions.explanation: Bellman-Ford can handle negative edge weights, unlike Dijkstra's which fails with negative weights.

questions.question: Floyd-Warshall algorithm is used for -
questions.explanation: Floyd-Warshall finds shortest paths between ALL pairs of vertices using dynamic programming.

Which algorithm uses a greedy approach to build MST by starting from a single vertex?
questions.explanation: Prim's algorithm builds MST by starting from a single vertex and greedily adding the minimum weight edge.

questions.question: Kruskal's algorithm for MST works by -

options.A: Starting from a vertex and adding nearest edges
options.B: Sorting edges by weight and adding them if no cycle is formed

questions.explanation: Kruskal's sorts all edges by weight, then adds them one by one to the MST if they don't form a cycle.

Topological sorting is possible only for -
questions.explanation: Topological sorting is only possible for Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) — graphs with no directed cycles.

In the division method of hashing, the hash function is -
questions.explanation: In the division method, h(k) = k mod m, where m is the table size. It maps key k to a slot.

questions.question: A minimum spanning tree of a graph with n vertices has exactly -
questions.explanation: A spanning tree of a graph with n vertices always contains exactly n - 1 edges.

questions.question: The time complexity of Dijkstra's algorithm using adjacency matrix representation is -
questions.explanation: Using an adjacency matrix, Dijkstra's algorithm runs in O(V²) time where V is the number of vertices.

The time complexity of Bellman-Ford algorithm is -
questions.explanation: Bellman-Ford relaxes all E edges for V-1 iterations, giving time complexity O(VE).

questions.question: The time complexity of Floyd-Warshall algorithm is -
questions.explanation: Floyd-Warshall uses three nested loops over V vertices, giving time complexity O(V³).
